name: How long does delivery take?
description: Within Lagos: 1 to 2 working days. Other states: 3 to 5 working days. You will get a tracking update once your order is dispatched.

name: How much is delivery?
description: Lagos delivery is 2,500 naira. Delivery to other states is 4,500 naira. Delivery is free for orders above 100,000 naira.

name: How do I pay?
description: You can pay by bank transfer or card through the secure payment link we send in the chat. We start production or dispatch only after payment is confirmed.

name: Do you accept returns?
description: Yes, within 7 days if the item is unused and in its original packaging. Custom and monogrammed items cannot be returned unless they are faulty.

name: Do you offer a warranty?
description: All bags come with a 1-year warranty against stitching and zip defects. Normal wear and tear is not covered.

name: Can I customise a bag?
description: Yes. We offer monograms, logo embossing and colour choices on most items. Custom orders take 5 to 7 working days.

name: Where are you located?
description: Our workshop and showroom are in Lekki Phase 1, Lagos. Visits are by appointment, so tell us when you would like to come.

name: What are your opening hours?
description: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays. You can message us any time and we reply during opening hours.

name: Do you do bulk or corporate orders?
description: Yes. For 5 or more items we offer bulk pricing and branded gift sets. A team member will confirm the quote, so please share the quantity and deadline.

name: Can I speak to a person?
description: Of course. Say so in the chat and a team member will take over.
